g.text: Does predicted benefit track measured geometric benefit?
The LLM labels each suggestion as low, medium or high expected benefit. Each dot shows how much that suggestion actually improves class separation when tested alone. Black marks show the
averages; n counts the suggestions. If the labels are useful, high should usually sit above medium and low. Empty groups have no evidence. This tests layout improvement, not prediction
